title: Customer Service Call
subtitle: Resolving a billing dispute — for English learners

sentences.en: Thank you for calling — my name is Jordan. How can I help you today?
sentences.target: Thank you for calling — my name is Jordan. How can I help you today?

sentences.en: Hi Jordan. I'm calling because I was charged twice for the same order last month.
sentences.target: Hi Jordan. I'm calling because I was charged twice for the same order last month.

sentences.en: I'm really sorry to hear that. Could you give me your account number so I can look into it?
sentences.target: I'm really sorry to hear that. Could you give me your account number so I can look into it?

sentences.en: It's seven-three-one-four-eight-two-zero, under the name Maria Lopez.
sentences.target: It's seven-three-one-four-eight-two-zero, under the name Maria Lopez.

sentences.en: Thank you. I can see two identical charges on March twelfth — that's clearly an error on our side.
sentences.target: Thank you. I can see two identical charges on March twelfth — that's clearly an error on our side.

sentences.en: I'd like to issue a full refund for the duplicate charge. Would that resolve the issue for you?
sentences.target: I'd like to issue a full refund for the duplicate charge. Would that resolve the issue for you?

sentences.en: Yes, that would be perfect. How long will the refund take to appear on my card?
sentences.target: Yes, that would be perfect. How long will the refund take to appear on my card?

sentences.en: Most refunds post within five to seven business days, depending on your bank.
sentences.target: Most refunds post within five to seven business days, depending on your bank.

sentences.en: I'll also send you a confirmation email with the reference number for your records.
sentences.target: I'll also send you a confirmation email with the reference number for your records.

sentences.en: Thanks for being so quick about this — I really appreciate it.
sentences.target: Thanks for being so quick about this — I really appreciate it.

sentences.en: Of course — and I apologize again for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can help with?
